sources.snippet: The Youtu-LLM model was proposed in Youtu-LLM Technical Report by Tencent Youtu Team. The abstract from the paper is the following: We introduce Youtu-LLM, a lightweight yet powerful language model that harmonizes high computational efficiency with native agentic intelligence.

sources.snippet: Youtu-LLM-2B-Base huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides Youtu-LLM-2B-Base's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this tencent Youtu-LLM-2B-Base model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the Youtu-LLM-2B-Base model, and also provides paid use of the Youtu-LLM-2B-Base. Support call Youtu-LLM-2B-Base model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
